card_en: Job names have a feminine form, mostly in -ica or -ka: učitelj, učiteljica; profesor, profesorica; študent, študentka. Slovenian has no word for a: sem učiteljica, I am a teacher.

quick_check.explain_en: A sister is a woman, so the job takes the feminine form učiteljica.

helper_de: As in German: Lehrer, Lehrerin. And as in German, no article: sem učiteljica, ich bin Lehrerin.
helper_en: English teacher covers both. Slovenian has two words, and no a: sem učitelj, I am a teacher.
